name: com.anotherealitysrl.virtuademy-sdk-environments
description: Everything a world is authored with: placeholder bases and the placeholder set, the Visual Scripting nodes, the object spawner and interaction contracts, client models, the task and dialog adapters, the analytics contract, and the editor publish tooling. Formerly six packages (Core, Placeholders, VisualScripting, Tasks, Dialogs, Analytics), merged at 9.0.0.

samples.description: Template scene with visual scripting network sample use
Contains nodes and event units that work with the splines packages of the Unity registry
Contains nodes and prefabs that work with the quiz and analytics logic. Both now ship in this package, so the sample no longer needs anything installed alongside it
Contains a sample scene to show how to use the task system
